method.value: The poster used Gemini in Chrome to book travel and other purchases, then wrote a reusable set of personal instructions so the agent would apply their preferences automatically. outcome.value: They say the booking experience was “mind blowing,” but give no hard metrics, examples of completed bookings, or comparison against doing it manually. The post is mainly a template of preferences rather than a detailed walkthrough of one booking run.

notes.value: The main catch is that this only works as well as the instructions you prepare; the poster explicitly says they used AI to keep refining and updating them.

source_text.body:
Book things with Chrome's Gemini agent
A user had Gemini in Chrome book things for them and used AI to craft prompts and instructions to improve agentic booking.
Done with
GE
Gemini
What they did
The poster used Gemini in Chrome to book travel and other purchases, then wrote a reusable set of personal instructions so the agent would apply their preferences automatically. Those instructions covered baggage and seat rules for flights, hotel filters like ratings, location and breakfast, rideshare defaults, delivery cost, and even movie-seat choices; in comments, the poster says they used AI to help craft and revise those prompts.
How it went
They say the booking experience was “mind blowing,” but give no hard metrics, examples of completed bookings, or comparison against doing it manually. The post is mainly a template of preferences rather than a detailed walkthrough of one booking run.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that this only works as well as the instructions you prepare; the poster explicitly says they used AI to keep refining and updating them.
Try it yourself
with
Gemini
Copy prompt
Use Agent Mode to book [what to book, e.g. a table for 4, a haircut, a hotel night] in [city/location] on [date and time window]. My preferences are [budget, cuisine or style, distance, must-haves]. Compare at least three options, recommend one, and take it through to the final confirmation screen. Pause before entering payment details or pressing the final confirm button so I can review the details, and stop once the booking is confirmed and you've given me the confirmation summary.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GoogleGeminiAI/comments/1qz3z2r/agentic_al_personal_instructions
